Start with your roof

Flat roof or steep slope? The fix is different.

New York buildings run both. Pick the roof you have and see the services built for it — then confirm the details on a free estimate call.

Representative photo

Flat roof specialists

Flat roofs fail at seams, drains and ponding spots — not always where the drip shows inside. Power Roofing NYC repairs and installs flat systems, and coats commercial roofs to extend their service life.
